items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Boo was working with me out of Universal... I asked about... I'd like to bring you to Houston... we rehearsed together... gave her a date to join me in Chicago... Boo stayed with me two years.

ctx.x: Is that when you had Boo Pleasant?
No, Boo was working with me out of Universal.
Oh, she was then. Oh, I'd never heard of her [before.]
